high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "misiawelters." The post features a close-up photograph of an eye with concentric circles drawn over it, representing different levels of consciousness according to Alan Watts' philosophy. The text overlay on the image includes a quote from Alan Watts: "Stay in the centre and you will be able to move in any direction." The concentric circles are labeled as follows: The innermost circle is labeled "PURE CONSCIOUSNESS." The next circle is labeled "COLLECTIVE UNCONSCIOUSNESS." The outermost circle is labeled "UNCONSCIOUS
